title: Let-Mi: An Arabic Levantine Twitter Dataset for Misogynistic Language
reasoning: The paper's annotation scheme for misogyny includes a novel category called "damning," which is defined as "the Arabic version of cursing where people ask God to make a woman ill, handicapped, dead, hurt, etc." and involves "prayers to hurt women." This category directly incorporates religious concepts (God, prayer, cursing) into the core classification task, which constitutes a component of evaluating language through a religious lens.
